meta.title: Annual Population Survey: employment, inactivity and qualifications
meta.quality: APS is a household survey; LA estimates rest on a few hundred respondents per LA (far fewer for 16-24 sub-groups). Nomis 95% CIs (`ci`, +/- percentage points) are typically +/-4-6 pts for 16-64 rates and +/-10-20 pts for youth rates or reasons for inactivity at LA level. LFS/APS is badged 'official statistics in development' after 2023-24 response-rate problems and reweighting.
meta.limitations: Values Nomis does not publish (sample size 0-2 / disclosive, '!') and estimates Nomis flags unreliable (sample 3-9, CI withheld, '*') are null with suppressed=true (180 rows) and the Nomis status in attrs.status; for '*' rows the published figure is kept in attrs.unreliable_estimate for reference only. Temporary-sick and discouraged reasons are suppressed for all three LAs. Annual points are the same rolling 12-month window each year (Jul-Jun), not calendar years. Year-to-year LA changes are usually within sampling error. Qualifications use RQF levels from 2022 (not comparable with older NVQ series) and are only released for Jan-Dec windows, so qualification rows have a different period. Reasons for inactivity sum to ~100% of inactive 16-64. num/den are survey-weighted counts rounded to the nearest 100. APS excludes most communal establishments (e.g. many student halls).

indicators.label: Employment rate 16-64
indicators.description: % of residents aged 16-64 in employment.

indicators.label: Unemployment rate 16-64 (APS direct)
indicators.description: Unemployed as % of economically active 16-64 (direct survey estimate; often unreliable at LA level - prefer the model-based rate).

indicators.label: Economic inactivity rate 16-64
indicators.description: % of residents aged 16-64 economically inactive. num = inactive count (rounded).

indicators.label: Inactive 16-64 who want a job
indicators.description: % of economically inactive 16-64 who say they want a job (latent labour supply).

indicators.label: Inactive: student
indicators.description: % of economically inactive 16-64 whose main reason is study.

indicators.label: Inactive: looking after family/home
indicators.description: % of economically inactive 16-64 looking after family or home.

indicators.label: Inactive: temporary sick
indicators.description: % of economically inactive 16-64 temporarily sick.

indicators.label: Inactive: long-term sick
indicators.description: % of economically inactive 16-64 who are long-term sick or disabled.

indicators.label: Inactive: discouraged
indicators.description: % of economically inactive 16-64 who believe no jobs are available.

indicators.label: Inactive: retired
indicators.description: % of economically inactive 16-64 who have retired (early retirement).

indicators.label: Inactive: other reason
indicators.description: % of economically inactive 16-64 inactive for other reasons.

indicators.label: Employment rate 16-24
indicators.description: % of residents aged 16-24 in employment (includes students).

indicators.label: Unemployment rate 16-24
indicators.description: Unemployed as % of economically active 16-24.

indicators.label: Economic inactivity rate 16-24
indicators.description: % of residents aged 16-24 economically inactive (mostly full-time students).

indicators.label: Employment rate 16-19
indicators.description: % of residents aged 16-19 in employment (most are in education).

indicators.label: Economic inactivity rate 16-19
indicators.description: % of residents aged 16-19 economically inactive.

indicators.label: Employment rate 20-24
indicators.description: % of residents aged 20-24 in employment.

indicators.label: Economic inactivity rate 20-24
indicators.description: % of residents aged 20-24 economically inactive.

indicators.label: 18-24 in full-time education
indicators.description: % of residents aged 18-24 in full-time education.

indicators.label: Economic inactivity rate 25-34
indicators.description: % of residents aged 25-34 economically inactive.

indicators.label: Economic inactivity rate 35-49
indicators.description: % of residents aged 35-49 economically inactive.

indicators.label: Economic inactivity rate 50-64
indicators.description: % of residents aged 50-64 economically inactive.

indicators.label: Qualified to RQF4+ (16-64)
indicators.description: % of residents aged 16-64 with RQF level 4 or above (degree, HND, higher apprenticeship). Published for Jan-Dec periods only.

indicators.label: Qualified to RQF3+ (16-64)
indicators.description: % of residents aged 16-64 with RQF level 3 or above (A level / equivalent). Published for Jan-Dec periods only.

indicators.label: Qualified to RQF2+ (16-64)
indicators.description: % of residents aged 16-64 with RQF level 2 or above (5 GCSE 9-4 / equivalent). Published for Jan-Dec periods only.

indicators.label: No qualifications (16-64)
indicators.description: % of residents aged 16-64 with no qualifications. Published for Jan-Dec periods only.

indicators.label: Unemployment rate 16+ (model-based)
indicators.description: ONS model-based LA unemployment rate (APS combined with claimant count); more reliable than the direct APS estimate at LA level.

indicators.label: Unemployed 16+ (model-based count)
indicators.description: ONS model-based estimate of unemployed residents 16+.
